description: Rank up to 200 caller-supplied documents with lexical BM25 and return top matches, scores and exact snippet offsets. No web search, embeddings or external fetches. Caller must have rights to supplied text. Costs $0.0018 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
name: document_search
title: Johto Data Document Search
